nodes.label: PCA of Audio Features Colored by SyncD
nodes.description: PCA scatter plot (n=447) with PC1 (25.8% variance) vs PC2 (18.3% variance), colored by SyncD (green=better, red=worse). No clear separation between high and low SyncD samples, suggesting audio features alone insufficient to predict lip-sync quality.

metadata.finding: Lip-sync quality not linearly separable in audio feature space; multimodal modeling needed
